anchor.title: Knows how to stop when running.

items.title: Rolls small paper or playdough balls with their hands.
Rolls playdough to make long strips by using hands or the table.
Jumps down from a height of about 18 inches.
Stacks 9 or more blocks.
Glues things onto paper.
Can draw or paint in circular motions.
Throws a big ball over their head with both hands.
Jumps ahead with both feet at once.

anchor.title: Sings a few words from a song.

items.title: Has toys 'talk' during pretend play.
Points to a square.
Identifies the sounds of musical instruments, like drums or guitar.
Identifies community helpers (like a doctor, policeman, or firefighter).
Sorts objects by their size, like finding all the little blocks from a pile of blocks.
Names or points to tools used in different jobs (like a doctor's stethoscope).
Knows the difference between 'front' and 'back'.
Can point to a circle.

anchor.title: Understands everyday actions, like play, run.

items.title: Answers simple questions about a story.
Uses fingers to tell their age.
Names and describes their drawings.
Says simple words with the letter F (like 'fish' or 'if').
Names smaller body parts (e.g., elbow and eyebrows).
Speaks around 50 words.
Uses words like 'I,' 'me,' and 'you'.
Can chat using two to three sentences.

anchor.title: Drinks from a cup with one hand.

items.title: Can say their first name, age, and gender.
Talks about what they are interested in.
Can open a big zipper.
Knows that some things belong to them and some don't.
Names a character's feelings in a story using pictures, like pointing to the happy character.
Can pull pants down.
Calls a friend by their name.
Shows empathy when they see a crying friend (e.g., will try to comfort them).

calibration.title: Recognizes things that are the same and when they're a bit different, like an item that is out of place.
Catches a ball with just their hands in the air.
Identifies situations and activities they they enjoy.
